h1: The 5 Best Mini PC Wall Mounts of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Mini PC Wall Mounts 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: five mini PC wall mounts, from an 11 lb steel bracket to an adhesive shelf, with real capacities, fit ranges and tradeoffs.
summary: The HumanCentric Thin Client Mount is the best for most mini PCs, with an 11 lb rating and a wide depth range. The VIVO bracket adds a 3-year warranty, the suptek adds open-frame airflow, the universal strap mount fits many Dell, Lenovo and HP models, and the NOTMBESTM shelf suits renters.
intro: Most mini PC mounts fail the same way: the bracket is the wrong width. A mini PC that is 2.6 inches thick will not sit in a bracket made for 2.55 inches, however sturdy the steel.
We reviewed mounts on their listed capacity, adjustable width, mounting options and cooling design. Five made the cut, ranked by how many mini PCs each is likely to hold safely.

products.name: HumanCentric Thin Client Mount Bracket, Wall Mount Option
products.verdict: The highest rated capacity here, with wall, VESA and pole options.
products.description:
The HumanCentric bracket carries 11 lb and fits devices from 0.65 to 2.55 inches deep. It mounts to a wall, VESA pattern or pole, ships with silicone scratch strips and a full hardware kit, and costs $25-50.

Top spot comes from capacity and range together. Against VIVO, it matches the 11 lb rating but costs more and lacks the longer warranty.

It suits a mini PC paired with a dock. Measure your device depth first, since 2.55 inches is the ceiling.
products.idealFor: Heavier mini PCs or PC and dock pairs.
products.skipIf: Your device is over 2.55 inches thick.

products.name: VIVO Adjustable Thin Client Mini PC Wall Mount Bracket
products.verdict: Powder-coated steel with a 3-year warranty at under $25.
products.description:
The VIVO bracket is solid powder-coated steel, adjusts from 1.8 cm to 7.1 cm wide, mounts to a wall, VESA pattern or pole, and holds 5 kg (about 11 lb). It comes with a 3-year warranty and costs under $25.

It ranks just below the HumanCentric because the listing adds no scratch strips. In exchange it costs less and has the longest warranty in this guide.

Buy it for a dependable low-cost mount. Check your device width against 7.1 cm.
products.skipIf: Your mini PC is thicker than 7.1 cm.

products.name: suptek Thin Client Mount Bracket, Wall Mount with Open-Frame Cooling
products.verdict: An open-frame steel bracket that keeps air moving around the PC.
products.description:
The suptek is a solid steel open-frame bracket adjusting from 0.6 to 2.7 inches wide, with an 11 lb capacity and wall, pole and under-desk mounting. It costs under $25.

It ranks third because airflow is its main advantage, not warranty or accessories. Against VIVO, it fits slightly thicker devices.

It suits tight corners where heat could build. The listing does not mention VESA mounting.

products.name: Universal Wall and VESA Mount for Micro PC, UPS Units, WiFi Router
products.verdict: A strap-based mount that fits a range of named Dell, Lenovo and HP models.
products.description:
This universal mount uses an adjustable strap for devices up to 17 inches in perimeter, and lists compatibility with Dell, Lenovo and HP mini PCs. It mounts on a wall or behind a monitor and costs under $25.

It ranks fourth because straps hold less rigidly than steel brackets. Against the Monzlteck-style plates, it handles odd shapes better.

It works well for routers, UPS units and micro PCs. No weight rating is listed.
products.skipIf: You want a rated steel bracket.

products.name: NOTMBESTM Adjustable Wall Mount Shelf for Mini PC, WiFi Router
products.verdict: A light shelf you can screw in or stick on.
products.description:
The NOTMBESTM shelf has an adjustable push plate from 0 to 65 mm, a limit under 3 kg (about 6.6 lbs), and screw or adhesive installation. It mounts to a wall, under a desk or behind a TV and costs under $25.

It ranks last because of the lower weight limit. Against the steel brackets above, it is a lighter option that avoids holes.

It suits renters with a light mini PC. Keep the device under 3 kg.
products.skipIf: Your PC or dock is heavy.

methodology.description: We checked the adjustable width or depth range.

methodology.title: Mounting options
methodology.description: We noted wall, VESA, pole and under-desk support.

whatMatters.detail: The bracket must fit your PC's thickness. Too tight and it will not slide in. Measure your device and compare with the stated range.
A rated capacity sets a safe limit for the PC plus any dock or cables. Light plastic shelves cap near 3 kg. Check the number in the listing.
Wall, VESA, pole or under-desk each suit different setups. Pick one that matches your layout. Look for the supported list.
Mini PCs run warm and trap heat in enclosed brackets. Open-frame designs let air flow. Check for open frame or vent details.
Drywall needs anchors, while adhesive suits smooth surfaces. Check which hardware is included.

faq.a: Compare your device depth and width with each listed range before buying.

faq.q: Can I mount behind a monitor?
faq.a: The universal mount lists behind-monitor mounting, and VESA brackets use the monitor's pattern.

faq.q: Is the HumanCentric worth it over VIVO?
faq.a: Only if you need depth up to 2.55 inches or scratch strips. VIVO is cheaper.
Use anchors into drywall unless you hit a stud. Check what is included.
Yes, in enclosed spots. Use the open-frame suptek.
Only for devices under the listed 3 kg and on clean smooth walls.

finalTake: The HumanCentric bracket is the safest default thanks to its 11 lb rating and VESA support. VIVO wins on warranty, suptek on airflow, and the NOTMBESTM shelf is the renter option for light devices.
